basics.summary: AI systems builder shipping agent orchestration, source-grounded research, retrieval and memory, voice interfaces, and full-stack public products.

work.name: Independent
work.summary: Self-directed engineering and operations across AI products, agent orchestration, research systems, retrieval, memory, voice and delivery infrastructure.
highlights: Built and operated multi-agent systems with typed contracts, task routing, provider-aware fallback, evidence receipts, review gates and explicit unknown states.
Built CaveMem and Glass Mem memory lanes around append-only event capture, SQLite/FTS5, embeddings, vector retrieval, source-linked recall and MCP access.
Built research and knowledge products for health, training and editorial work, carrying source context into user-facing retrieval and decision surfaces.
Built evidence-first GitHub PR operations with independent gather/decide/review/act stages, head-pinned decisions, CI-step evidence, GitHub API/SSE/MCP integration and human escalation.
Built provider-neutral model workflows using Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama, Gemini and local OpenAI-compatible services, with model routing and measured evaluation.
Built public products including The Drop, SD Forest / Forest HUB, GymScholar, Open Dashboard, Repo Shelf, MoneyWolf, Avatar Playground and the combined Health route.
Built voice and multimodal systems using realtime model APIs, ElevenLabs, Cartesia, Google TTS, Pocket TTS, Kokoro, browser audio and messaging surfaces.
Worked across Windows/PowerShell, Vercel, GitHub Pages, Oracle/VPS/KVM2, Docker/Compose, Caddy, systemd, GCP Secret Manager, n8n, GitHub Actions, Tailscale and RunPod.
Built the native Glass Council client surface in Kotlin Compose Multiplatform for Windows and Android alongside its Python engine and MCP server.

projects.name: The Drop
projects.description: A daily and weekly publication in English and Bulgarian. It organizes research and editorial content, sends editions through Telegram, and offers narration with ElevenLabs.

projects.name: SD Forest / Forest HUB
projects.description: A public home for my projects, learning tools and research pages. It combines static web pages with FastAPI and SQLite services, including interactive 3D views and AI indexes.

projects.name: GymScholar
projects.description: A training app for building workout routines, setting custom schedules and rest/break intervals, and targeting specific muscle groups. What sets it apart is that its training engine is built entirely on peer-reviewed exercise science papers turned into evidence-based claims, rather than gym lore or bro-science.

projects.name: Open Dashboard
projects.description: A dashboard for comparing AI models, their capabilities and provider costs. It shows the provider data behind comparisons and includes an MCP service for accessing that information.

projects.name: 3D Repo Shelf
projects.description: A GitHub repository browser built around an interactive 3D bookshelf. Repositories can also be explored through search, categories, graph views and cards describing what they do. Explore Repos is part of the same project.

projects.name: MoneyWolf
projects.description: An experimental finance desk where several agents review sources, assess risk and track simulated trades in a local database. It is read-only and paper-only: it does not place real orders. Repeated events are handled without duplicating actions.

projects.name: Avatar Playground / Voice Playground
projects.description: A browser playground for testing how an avatar responds to audio, voice, gestures and connection changes. It connects Chloe’s avatar to its running system and brings the earlier voice experiments into one place.

projects.name: Unified Reader + Audiobook Studio
projects.description: Reading and audiobook tools grouped on one public Health page. The tools support EPUB and PDF reading, accessible reader controls, and audiobook creation with several text-to-speech options.

projects.name: Women's Health OS
projects.description: A work-in-progress app for exploring women’s health research through papers, facts and claims linked to evidence. The public page is available, but its data-loading state still needs review: an online API alone does not mean the research data is ready.
projects.dataQualityFlag: The user-reported zero-facts/zero-papers state is retained as a review warning. Fresh async readback on 2026-10-21 eventually showed non-zero counters; do not hide the warning or fix the product in this task.

projects.name: Glass Mem
projects.description: A memory system for agents that keeps original events without overwriting them. It uses SQLite/FTS5 search, embeddings and vector retrieval to find relevant context, with links back to the source events and access through MCP.

projects.name: Glass Council
projects.description: A private, in-development system for comparing input from independent models. It has a Python engine, an MCP server, and a Kotlin Compose Multiplatform client for Windows and Android. It is separate from the Claude Code planning framework.
projects.publicSurfaceNote: No public browser URL was verified; do not substitute the public round-table council route or the Claude Code council repository.

projects.name: Glass PR Solver
projects.description: An in-development tool for reviewing GitHub pull requests. It gathers code changes, CI results and model review records, checks which commit was reviewed, and asks for human help when a run is blocked or out of date rather than marking it approved.

projects.name: Cognitive Autonomy / Firsthand
projects.description: An in-development tool for recording a person’s own observations before asking a model to interpret them. Structured records keep the original evidence separate from the model’s interpretation.
